cases.task: In boltons.iterutils, chunked accepts an optional count parameter. Passing a negative count (count < 0) bypasses parameter validation and crashes internally in itertools.islice with a standard library error. Validate count using _validate_positive_int(count, 'chunk count', strictly_positive=False) when count is not None, raising ValueError mentioning chunk count on negative count. Preserve count=0, positive count, count=None, and fill keyword arguments. Add regression tests to tests/test_iterutils.py and run that file.
